text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: KV allocator fragmentation spike detected on prod-gpu-pool-7; error rate and tail latency elevated for inference-web endpoints. Auto-escalation triggered. thread_ts=2331122334

mel: seeing a huge jump in CUDA OOMs + allocation failures. Grafana shows a fragmentation metric rising rapidly on a subset of nodes. customers hitting 503s.

raj: I can take first stab. which job started at ~22:15 UTC? any recent deploys?

sophia: no user-facing deploys in last hour. we did change continuous-batching config in the autoscaler PR earlier today (batch_max_kv_slots=2048 -> 4096). linking diff: https://git.redwood/infer/changes/987

dario: that aligns. increasing batch slots increases per-request cached KV allocations -> more arena pressure. Noticed slab amplification on nodes with high seq_len.

mel: copying relevant logs from a repro node:```
[2026-03-14T22:28:03Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (total_allocated=19.4GB, arena_reserved=21.0GB)
[2026-03-14T22:28:03Z] kv_arena: slab_fragmentation_ratio=0.78, active_slots=3912, free_slots=24
[2026-03-14T22:28:04Z] continuous_batcher: batch_size=64, kv_slots_requested=4096
```

ops-bot: Auto-remediation attempt: rolled back continuous-batching config on pool prod-gpu-pool-7 to batch_max_kv_slots=2048 at 22:36 UTC. Initiated drain of hot nodes.

sophia: rollback brought down new allocations but we still see elevated fragmentation and some OOMs during short GC windows. Looks like the allocator isn't compacting fast enough.

raj: Can we trigger arena compaction now? what's the supported command?

mel: run on the node: `sudo systemctl isolate kv-arena-compact@<node>` — that's the one-time compaction job. I'll queue it on the worst offenders.

dario: doing compaction on node gpu-7-12 now. ETA 60s.

mel: customer-impact: certain mid-size customers (embedding-heavy workloads) saw 5-10% request failures over 22:20-22:40 UTC, and increased latency PD95 from 120ms -> 1.2s. Support notified.

support-liaison: I've opened a support ticket and proactively messaged affected customers with a brief: "We're aware of transient failures affecting embeddings; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up with timeline and RCA."

oncall-bot: @oncall reread: mel is handing over. Next oncall please join for night ops.

elaine: I'm taking handoff for night ops. summary?

mel: tl;dr: batch config change earlier increased KV allocations -> allocator fragmentation + slower compactions -> OOMs during GC. rollback reduced allocation pressure but fragmentation persists on some arenas. we've run targeted compactions and are patching the allocator to more aggressively coalesce small slabs.

elaine: ok. what's the immediate mitigation plan and timeline?

raj: immediate steps we executed: 1) rolled back batch_max_kv_slots on pool -> done 22:36; 2) drained and compacted top-6 nodes -> started 22:38 completed 22:46; 3) enabled temporary per-model kv-slot caps (limit 1024) for embedding models -> rolled policy at 22:50.

mel: longer-term hotfix being prepared: change allocator free-list coalescing threshold and add a background compaction worker. I have a draft PR with tests. patch branch: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/patch/kv-arena-coalesce-2026

dario: quick patch note: increase contiguous-merge-window from 8KB -> 64KB and reduce eviction grace interval to 5s. In our dev repro this reduced fragmentation ratio from 0.78 -> 0.21.

sophia: can we feature-flag the patch and trial on a canary pool before rolling wide? we should also add a reclaim metric and alert on compaction lag.

elaine: yes feature flag + canary. schedule a canary sweep at 03:00 UTC (low traffic). if canary looks good, gradual rollout with monitoring for 30m windows.

ops-bot: Deploy job started for canary group 'kv-arena-canary-2' with tag kv-coalesce-v1 at 03:00 UTC. job_id=deploy-2331124-c1

mel: note for post-incident: correlate batch config changes with allocator metrics before changes are merged. add a pre-merge safety check: simulated worst-case kv_slots per node. Also add runbook step to consider temporary per-model caps if allocator pressure rises.

sophia: logs for the compaction runs:```
[compaction gpu-7-12] start 22:39
free_ranges_before=34 total_slab=12GB fragmented=8.9GB
coalesce_pass_1: merged 18 ranges
coalesce_pass_2: merged 6 ranges
free_ranges_after=10 fragmented=1.7GB
status OK
```

raj: ask infra: do we need to tweak pytorch caching knobs (cudacache) to avoid double-buffering with the arena?

dario: good call — there's interplay. lowering pytorch caching from 40% -> 20% of GPU mem on affected nodes gave additional headroom in a local test. we'll coordinate with infra for a conservative change if fragmentation recurs.

support-liaison: customers updated. one customer asked for SLA credit; logged for postmortem.

elaine: handoff checklist posted to ops-notes: what we did, which nodes are still being monitored, PR links, customer tickets. I'll be monitoring alarms and can take the rollback further if we see another surge.

mel: thanks team — great rapid coordination. please add any follow-ups as TODOs in the incident doc (link incoming).

ops-bot: Incident runbook updated: incident-2331122334.md created in /incidents/postmortems/ (private).

oncall-bot: incident severity set to Sev2. Pager cleared for now; reopen if critical regressions recur. :thumbsup:

sophia: adding metric requests: compaction_lag_seconds, slab_fragmentation_ratio (per-arena), kv_slots_in_use. will add to dashboards and set thresholds.

dario: PR ready for review; I'm tagging mel and raj. will not merge until canary passes.

mel: leaving notes for Elaine: if compaction_lag > 120s across >3 nodes or OOM rate > 1% for 5m, escalate to SRE and consider a temporary service-wide throttle on embeddings.

elaine: acknowledged, monitoring now. I'll update thread if anything changes.

support-liaison: logging final customer summary and follow-up schedule for tomorrow's outreach.

mel: postmortem owners: mel (technical), support-liaison (customer comms). target draft by 2026-03-16 EOD.

sophia: adding evals to detect regression in perf cliffs when batch_max_kv_slots increases — automatic gating for future PRs.

mel: thanks. closing handoff.
